name: C^3-Benchmark
intro: C3-Bench 先从 400 个公开 API 工具按 50 类扩展到 1,600 个工具/函数，经混元 TurboS 修订描述、扩展枚举/数组/对象参数并由五位专家验证，再用五角色框架生成 256 条单任务和 768 条多任务数据。工具依赖、隐藏信息和决策历史作为三个独立评测挑战。
build_method: 400个API工具到50类和1,600个工具/函数, LLM描述修订, 参数扩展, 五位专家验证, 五角色任务生成与多轮审核
metric: Accuracy, Accomplish Progress, Optimal Path Rate, Policy Transition Frequency, Volatility Factor, Debiased Descent Direction
task_type: 多任务Agent, 工具调用, 上下文依赖, 决策轨迹鲁棒性
eval_feature: 完整有效路径枚举, 增量决策树匹配, Omit/Reference/Long控制, Challenge 2/3配对比较
scale: 256条单任务, 768条多任务; 2-4个相关任务; 336种策略切换类型; 49个Agent
drawio_review_note: REDRAW. Reviewed against arXiv:2505.18746v4 Appendix A.1.1 and official repository commit 1aab165c435ac93e24cbf5bcea0e5bda29fbbf09. The construction now begins with the disclosed 400 public API tools → 50 categories → 1,600 tools/functions chain, followed by HunYuan-TurboS description revision, enum/array/object parameter expansion, and verification by five LLM-agent experts. The unsupported fifteen-role-subtype claim was removed. Tool dependencies and Omit/Reference/Long hidden information are confined to Challenges 1 and 2 after release; Challenge 3 injects correct prior actions and observations.
task_type_en: Multi-task agent, tool calling, context dependency, decision-trajectory robustness
build_method_en: 400 API tools to 50 categories and 1,600 tools/functions, LLM description revision, parameter expansion, five-expert verification, then five-role generation and multi-stage review
eval_feature_en: Complete valid-path enumeration, incremental decision-tree matching, Omit/Reference/Long controls, paired Challenge 2/3 comparison
intro_en: C3-Bench first expands 400 public API tools in 50 categories into 1,600 tools/functions, revises descriptions with HunYuan-TurboS, expands enum/array/object parameters, and verifies them with five experts. A five-role framework then generates 256 single-task and 768 multi-task entries; tool dependencies, hidden information, and decision history are isolated as three post-release evaluation challenges.
